customer_reply: Hello, thank you for reaching out to Zycus Support. We have verified your report and confirmed that this is tied to an active system-wide incident (INC-26-0418) affecting invoice OCR processing with error E-4102 following release 26.2.3. Our Engineering team is actively working on a hotfix. In the meantime, as a temporary workaround, you can switch affected invoice channels to Manual Entry mode via Admin > eInvoice > Channels for time-sensitive invoices while we work to resolve this. We will keep you updated as soon as the hotfix is deployed.
